frames_stats.note: n >= 20: an interval is still not computed by this smoke tool

aggregate.note: descriptive only: this block is not a development score and its clear_rate is not a pass rate

verdict.what_this_is: smoke: the v410 checkpoint ran in the real engine under the S1N dev ruler

limits: This is a SMOKE, not a development score: a handful of dev episodes has no interval and licenses no arm comparison. The pre-registered formal protocol is 20 dev episodes per arm on all four arms (B0/B1/B2/B3).
The checkpoint is a WP04.2 behaviour-cloning baseline (chosen one-hot CE on D410-S1), not an RL-trained policy and not the final student.
No G410-2 conclusion: no confirm seeds (60000-60199), no 20-episode protocol, no four-arm matrix, no gate, no pass rate. Frames/deaths/stop_reason are the only measurements here.
The confirm split is refused by check_seed_policy and the D410-S1 corpus seeds 1-20 are refused too, so a checkpoint can never be scored on a seed it saw.
The policy sees only pixels + its own action history; the engine STATE reply is a referee for death/stage/score, never an input.
not_claimed: not evidence that the WP04.2 BC matrix works in closed loop
